title: (no screen of its own: the app's home address)
summary: Opening the app's plain address never shows a page: it sends each person straight to where their work starts, or to the first screen they chose on My account.

who.can: lands on Dashboard (or their chosen first screen)
lands on Dashboard (or their chosen first screen)
lands on Dashboard (or their chosen first screen)

get_there: Type the app's address, tap the app's icon on a phone or till, sign in, or tap the café's name… any way into the app with no page named. Signing in also ends here.
before: The app must have its database set (otherwise it goes to “Not configured”, /setup).

parts.name: Where you are sent
parts.shows: Nothing is shown. In order: no database set → /setup. Not signed in → the sign-in page. Signed in but the second step not done → the code page (/login/verify). Signed in but not linked to the café, or deactivated → My account, which says “Your login is not linked to the business yet”. Otherwise: the first screen you chose on My account, as long as your roles still open it; if not, your role's screen: Dashboard for those who see profit and also sell (owner, general manager, branch manager); Reports for those who see profit but do not sell (accountant, auditor); Production for the barista; POS for the cashier; Stock Count for the inventory counter; Purchasing for purchasing; otherwise Inventory, Reports or My account.

states.looks: You arrive at your start screen at once.
The sign-in page.
My account, with “Your login is not linked to the business yet” and your email; ask the owner to add you on Settings → People and roles with exactly that email.
The “Not configured” page.

skipped_messages: Messages that every screen can show (session ended, no permission, the database did not answer, retry key, missing database update) are listed once, under “(every screen)”.

what_if.case: I always land on a screen I do not want
what_if.do: Open My account → First screen and choose the screen you want. It follows your sign-in to any phone or till.

what_if.case: My chosen first screen stopped opening
what_if.do: Your roles changed and no longer open it, so you are sent to your role's screen. Choose another first screen on My account.

tips: The address with a screen named (for example /end-of-day) goes straight there; after signing in you are taken back to the screen you asked for.

title: Not configured

who.can: see this page without signing in
who.cannot: do anything here; it has no buttons

get_there: You are sent here from any address when the database connection is not set. If the connection is set, opening /setup sends you to the home address instead.

parts.shows: Heading “Not configured”, then: “This deployment has no database connection, so it shows nothing and records nothing. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for the environment and deploy again.” and “There is intentionally no built-in default: a copy of the app must never write to another business's books by accident. See docs/guides/deployment.md.” The top bar shows only the app's name, the connection badge, the language list and the theme button: no menu.

states.looks: The card above. Nothing else can be opened.
You never see this page: it sends you to the home address.

messages.text: This deployment has no database connection, so it shows nothing and records nothing. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for the environment and deploy again.

title: Settings
summary: How the café is set up, in six folded groups: Selling (ways to pay, service charge, the receipt), People and roles, Rules and warnings (rules, alert limits, phone warnings, who reads the watch list), Places, Languages, and The café's details. Each group's heading says what is turned on inside it.

who.can: everything on the page, including giving or taking the Owner and General manager roles, deactivating any person but themselves, and choosing whether the general manager reads the watch list
who.cannot: deactivate themselves; change the café's details (name, currency, timezone, default language, bill numbers) — there is no screen for them
tick the Owner or General manager role (the boxes are greyed: “Only the owner can give this role”), change the roles or access of an owner or general manager, or see the watch list box

who.role: branch_manager, cashier, barista, inventory_counter, purchasing, accountant, auditor
who.cannot: open Settings: the menu does not show it, and typing the address sends them to their own start screen

get_there: Menu → Accountant → Settings. Also: Find anything (Ctrl+K) → “Settings”; Sales → “Add them on Settings → Ways to pay.”; an address with a part named, for example /settings#receipt or /settings#phone-warnings, opens that group and scrolls to that part.

parts.name: Heading
parts.shows: “Settings”, and under it: “Each heading says what is turned on inside it. Open one to change it.”

parts.name: Not set up yet
parts.shows: A card shown only while something is not set up, in this order, each as a link and why it is worth doing: “Your own receipt — Your logo, your name and thanks in three languages, the Wi-Fi and a QR code on every receipt.” (nothing of the receipt given yet); “Ways to pay — The apps and banks you are paid through, each with its own account, so their money is counted apart.” (no way to pay besides cash and card); “Phone warnings — The Dashboard's warnings sent to your phone within minutes, wherever you are.” (phone warnings off for the café); “Service charge — A percentage added at the table or wherever you choose, kept apart from the sales.” (no service charge on any way of selling).

controls.label: Your own receipt / Ways to pay / Phone warnings / Service charge
controls.does: Opens the group that holds it and scrolls to that part.

parts.name: Selling (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “Selling” with what is on: “No service charge” or “Service charge on {ways}” (each way with its percentage, e.g. “Dine-in 10%”); “Cash and card only” or “{n} way(s) to pay besides cash and card”; “Your own receipt” or “The app's own receipt”. Tap the heading to open or fold it.

controls.label: Selling
controls.does: Opens or folds the group.

parts.name: Selling → Ways to pay
parts.shows: “Cash and the card machine are always taken. Add the apps and banks the café is paid through: each gets an account of its own, where its money stays until it is moved, on Sales.” A table of the café's ways to pay: “Way to pay” (its name), “Its account” (its own account number in the books, 1030 onwards), “At the till” (“offered” or “out of use”). Before database update 0069 the part only says “This needs the database update 0069, which has not been applied yet.”

controls.label: + FIB / + FastPay / + ZainCash / + Qi Card
controls.does: “Add with one press:” — adds that way to pay at once. Only those not added yet are shown.
controls.after: A new account for it is made in the books (1030 onwards). The till offers it from now on; Sales, End of Day and the reports show its money. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Another, by its name
controls.does: Type the name of any other app or bank the café is paid through.
controls.rules: 1 to 40 letters. The name must not be one the café already has (case and spaces ignored).

controls.label: Add
controls.does: Adds the way to pay typed in the box.
controls.rules: Off while the box is empty. At most 60 ways to pay in all.
controls.after: As for the one-press buttons: its own account, offered at the till.

controls.label: Rename
controls.does: Turns the name into a box (“New name for {name}”), with “Save” and “Cancel”.
controls.after: Save renames it and its account in the books; the money in the account stays. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Take out of use
controls.does: Stops offering it at the till.
controls.after: The till no longer offers it. Its account keeps what it holds; move that money on Sales. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Bring back
controls.does: Shown instead of “Take out of use” for one out of use: offers it at the till again.

parts.name: Selling → Service charge
parts.shows: “A percentage added to what the products come to, on each way of selling you choose — or on none. The till adds it when a sale or a table's bill is paid, and the receipt shows it. It is the café's own money, kept apart from the sales.” One row per way of selling the café uses itself (Dine-in, Takeaway, Direct delivery — delivery platforms are not listed: a platform sets what its customers pay), with its percentage or “None”. Before update 0090: “This needs the database update 0090, which has not been applied yet.”

controls.label: Service charge on {way} (%)
controls.does: The percentage for that way of selling.
controls.rules: 0 to 50; decimals allowed; empty or 0 means none.

controls.label: Save
controls.does: Saves the percentage for that way of selling.
controls.after: The till adds it to every sale or table bill of that way of selling paid from now on; the bill and receipt show it. It goes to its own account in the books (4300 Service charge), not to sales. Bills already paid do not change. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Turn off
controls.does: Shown only when it is on: empties the box and saves none.
controls.after: No service charge on that way of selling from now on.

parts.name: Selling → The receipt
parts.shows: “What the bill, the receipt and a refund's slip print besides the sale: your logo, your name and thanks in the three languages, your pages, the Wi-Fi, and a QR code to your menu or your reviews.” A form on one side and, on the other, “As it prints”: a made-up receipt (Test line, Another test line, 10,000) that changes as you type. Before update 0091: “This needs the database update 0091, which has not been applied yet.”

controls.label: Choose a logo
controls.does: Opens the picker for a picture. The picture is made small on the device (at most 320 px on its longer side) and saved at once. Shown as “Choose another logo” once there is one. Until a logo is given the café's emblem prints.
controls.rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP; smaller than 60 KB after it is made small. “It prints in black and white. A dark logo on a light background prints best.”
controls.after: Every bill, receipt and refund slip prints it from now on. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Take the logo off
controls.does: Removes the logo at once; the emblem prints again.
controls.after: On the audit trail.

controls.label: The café's name: In Arabic / In Kurdish
controls.does: The café's name in Arabic and in Kurdish, printed under its own name.
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters each; optional.

controls.label: Thank-you line: In English / In Arabic / In Kurdish
controls.does: A thank-you line in each language. With none given, the app's own thanks prints.
controls.rules: Up to 120 letters each; optional.

controls.label: Your pages: Instagram / Facebook / TikTok
controls.does: The café's pages, printed on the receipt.
controls.rules: Instagram and TikTok up to 60 letters, Facebook up to 80. A leading @ is dropped for Instagram and TikTok.

controls.label: Wi-Fi: The Wi-Fi's name / Its password
controls.does: The Wi-Fi printed for customers.
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters each.

controls.label: No QR code / Our menu / Tell us how we did
controls.does: Where the QR code on the receipt leads: nowhere, the menu, or the reviews. Choosing one shows its link box.
controls.rules: “A customer scans it with a phone's camera. The menu can be a page or a PDF you share; for reviews, the link Google Maps gives to write one.”

controls.label: The link to your menu / The link to your reviews page
controls.does: The address the QR code opens.
controls.rules: Required for the choice made; starts with https:// and has no spaces; up to 300 letters.

controls.label: A line at the foot
controls.does: One line printed at the bottom, e.g. “An address, a phone number, opening hours…”.
controls.rules: Up to 200 letters.

controls.label: Save the receipt
controls.does: Saves every box of the form at once (the logo is saved on its own when chosen).
controls.after: The till, Orders and Test your devices print it from now on. Receipts already printed do not change. On the audit trail (the receipt before and after).

parts.name: People and roles (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “People and roles” with “People: {n}” (active people).

controls.label: People and roles
controls.does: Opens or folds the group.

parts.name: People and roles → People
parts.shows: “Add a person with their email and role. They then open this app, choose “First time here?”, and create their login with that same email; once they confirm it, they are in — with exactly what their role allows. Deactivating someone takes effect on their very next click.” A table: “Name” (yours marked “(you)”), “Email”, “Roles”, “Works at” (only when the café has more than one place in use), “Login”: “invited” (not signed in yet), “signed in”, or “deactivated” (row greyed).

controls.label: Roles
controls.does: Turns the person's roles into tick boxes, with “Save” and “Cancel”.
controls.rules: At least one role (Save is off with none). Roles: Owner, General manager, Branch manager, Cashier, Barista / production, Inventory counter, Purchasing, Accountant, Read-only auditor.
controls.who: Only the owner can tick or untick Owner and General manager, or change the roles of an owner or general manager.
controls.after: What they can see and do changes on their next click, everywhere. Giving Owner or General manager makes them work everywhere. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Deactivate
controls.does: Stops the person at once. Not shown on your own row.
controls.who: Only the owner can deactivate an owner or a general manager.
controls.after: From their very next click they can read and do nothing; their login sends them to My account (“not linked”). Their past work stays. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Reactivate
controls.does: Shown for a deactivated person: lets them in again with the roles they had.

controls.label: Where {name} works
controls.does: In the “Works at” column: “Everywhere”, or one of the café's places. Saved as soon as it is chosen.
controls.rules: Off for an owner or general manager (they work everywhere) and for a deactivated person.
controls.after: The database then refuses anything they record at another place; their Start and End of Day are that place's. On the audit trail.

parts.name: People and roles → Add a person
parts.shows: Under the table: “Add a person”.

controls.label: Name
controls.does: Their name.
controls.rules: Required; up to 120 letters.

controls.label: Email
controls.does: The email they will create their login with.
controls.rules: Required; a real email address. Saved in small letters.

controls.label: Role tick boxes
controls.does: Their roles; Cashier is ticked to start with.
controls.rules: At least one.
controls.who: Owner and General manager can be ticked only by the owner.

controls.label: Works at
controls.does: Shown when the café has more than one place: “Everywhere” or one place.
controls.rules: Off (Everywhere) when Owner or General manager is ticked.

controls.label: Add person
controls.does: Adds the person as “invited”.
controls.rules: Off until name, email and a role are given.
controls.after: Nothing in the books. They can now create their login with that email (“First time here?” on the sign-in page). On the audit trail.

parts.name: People and roles → Roles & what they may do
parts.shows: “Enforced by the database on every read and write — the screens only follow it. A cashier sells but never sees a cost; a counter never sees what the ledger expects; a count is approved by someone other than its counter; only the owner reopens a locked period.” A card per role listing its permission codes (for example sale.create, cost.view, settings.manage). Read only.

parts.name: Rules and warnings (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “Rules and warnings” with “Phone warnings on” or “Phone warnings off” (nothing before update 0072).

controls.label: Rules and warnings
controls.does: Opens or folds the group.

parts.name: Rules and warnings → Rules
parts.shows: “The discount a cashier gives without a manager, the refunds and losses a second person approves, and what happens when more stock is used than the books hold. Each is changed on Rules, with a reason, and every change is kept.” A table of every rule's value for the whole café (e.g. “Refunds a second person approves — 25,000 IQD”), with “· {n} more for roles or items” when the rule is also set for roles, kinds of item, items or branches. Read only here.

controls.label: Open Rules →
controls.does: Opens Settings → Rules, where each rule is changed.

controls.label: The general manager reads the watch list too
controls.does: Ticked: the general manager also sees Reports → watch list. Saved at once.
controls.who: Only the owner sees this box (and only after database update 0094).
controls.after: The general manager gains or loses the watch list. On the audit trail.

parts.name: Rules and warnings → Alerts
parts.shows: “The dashboard checks the books against these each time it opens, and says what needs someone: red now, orange soon. Leave a box empty to follow its default. How long a supplier takes to deliver is set on each vendor (Vendors → Edit); this is for the rest.” One box per limit, each with “Default {default} · {min} to {max}” and, when changed, “ · now {value}”. The limits (default; allowed): “Days a delivery takes (vendors without their own)” (1; 0 to 30, whole), “Margin target (%)” (70; 0 to 95), “Hours a stock count may stay open” (8; 1 to 72, whole), “Waste spike: times a usual week” (1.5; 1 to 10), “Waste spike: at least (IQD)” (20,000; 0 to 100,000,000, whole), “Exceptions by one person in 7 days” (10; 1 to 1,000, whole), “Exceptions as a share of their sales (%)” (3; 0.1 to 100), “Days card money takes to reach the bank” (3; 1 to 30, whole), “Days a delivery platform takes to pay” (7; 1 to 60, whole), “Days before a bill is due to warn” (3; 0 to 30, whole), “Price typo: times another channel's price” (3; 1.5 to 20), “Hours a cash session may stay open” (14; 1 to 72, whole), “A cash session short by at least (IQD)” (5,000; 0 to 100,000,000, whole), “Usage unlike the recipes by at least (%)” (10; 1 to 100), “Usage unlike the recipes by at least (IQD)” (5,000; 0 to 100,000,000, whole).

controls.label: (each limit)
controls.does: Type a new limit, or empty the box to follow the default again. The default shows faintly in an empty box.
controls.rules: Within the limit's range; “whole” ones take whole numbers only.

controls.label: Save thresholds
controls.does: Saves every box that changed, together. Shows “Saving…” while it works.
controls.after: The Dashboard's alerts (and phone warnings) use the new limits from the next time they are checked. On the audit trail as a change to the business.

parts.name: Rules and warnings → Phone warnings
parts.shows: “The warnings of the dashboard, sent to the phones of those who see them, in each one's language, within about five minutes. Turned on here once for the café; then each person turns them on on a phone, on My account.” When on: a badge “On, for {n} phone(s)”. Before update 0072: “This needs the database update 0072, which has not been applied yet.”

controls.label: Turn phone warnings on for the café
controls.does: Turns them on, and the app makes the café's keys for sending.
controls.after: Each person who sees the Dashboard can now turn warnings on on their phone (My account → Warnings on this phone). Alerts already open are not sent; only new ones. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Turn phone warnings off for the café
controls.does: Shown when on: turns them off.
controls.after: Nothing more is sent to any phone; warnings waiting to be sent are dropped. Phones stay registered for when it is turned on again. On the audit trail.

parts.name: Places (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “Places” with “{n} branch(es)” and, if there are others, “{n} other place(s)”.

controls.label: Places
controls.does: Opens or folds the group.

parts.name: Places → Locations
parts.shows: Every place: its name, its kind (“Branch”, “Central kitchen” or “Warehouse”) and “active” or “inactive”. Places cannot be added or renamed here. When the menu has sections in use, each branch also shows what it sells: “Sells everything” (none chosen) or “Sells only:” and a button for each section.

controls.label: (a section's name)
controls.does: Tap to add or take away that section for that branch; saved at once. With none chosen the branch sells everything.
controls.after: The till at that branch shows only the products of the chosen sections. Nothing in the books changes. On the audit trail.

parts.name: Languages (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “Languages” with “English, Arabic and Kurdish”. Inside: “Every screen is in English, Arabic and Kurdish. Add another language, or give any phrase the café's own words.”

controls.label: Open Languages →
controls.does: Opens Settings → Languages.

parts.name: The café's details (folded group)
parts.shows: Heading “The café's details” with the currency and timezone. Inside, “Business configuration”: “Business name”; “Currency” — “{code} — {n} decimal places”; “Timezone” — “{timezone} — every trading day and period runs midnight to midnight here”; “Default language”; “Bill numbers” — “{prefix}-{year}-0001, -0002 … for a bill entered without the supplier's number: never given twice, never typed in by hand”. Then: “These are changed in the database by the owner; there is no screen for them yet.” Read only.

states.looks: Every group folded; only the headings, their status lines and (if anything is missing) “Not set up yet”.
That group opens by itself and the page scrolls to the part.
No “Not set up yet” card.
The part says “This needs the database update {0069, 0090, 0091 or 0072}, which has not been applied yet.” and its status is left off the heading.
No “Works at” column and no Works at list when adding a person.
Places shows no “Sells everything / Sells only:” buttons.
A yellow line “⏳ Your previous submission may already have been saved. Checking…” while it is sent again (ways to pay, people being added, phone warnings, sections).
Owner and General manager boxes greyed; no watch list box.

title: Rules

Each rule can have a value for the whole café and, for some, for a role, a kind of item or one item. Every change needs a reason and is kept.

get_there: Settings → Rules and warnings → “Open Rules →”. Also: Dashboard → “Give the café a day's sales target, and today is measured against it.” (opens at that rule); an address like /settings/rules#rule-refund_approval_over opens at one rule.

A rule set for a role, a kind of item or one item is used before the whole café's. Every change takes a reason, and is kept below and on the audit trail.” (folded behind “How this works”).

The rules, with kind, limits, default and what they can be set for: “A day's net sales target” — amount; 0 to 1,000,000,000 IQD, whole; 0 shows “No target”; default 0 (no target); for the whole café (a branch's row can exist but is not added here). “Labour cost the café aims for (% of net sales)” — percent; 1 to 100,000 IQD, whole; default 500 IQD; for the whole café. “Refunds a second person approves” — amount; 0 to 100,000,000 IQD, whole; default 25,000 IQD; for the whole café, a role. “Losses a manager approves” — amount; 0 to 100,000,000 IQD, whole; default 50,000 IQD; for the whole café, a role. “One person's losses are added up over” — choice; “Each loss on its own”, “Their cash session, or their day”, “The day”; default Their cash session, or their day; for the whole café. “Using more stock than the books hold” — choice; “Refused”, “A manager approves it”, “Allowed, with a red alert”, and for one item only “Allowed, with no alert”; default Allowed, with a red alert (Refused for finished goods and sub-recipes); for the whole café, a kind of item, one item. “A dollar rate is used for” — hours; 1 to 168 hours, whole; default 36 hours; for the whole café. “Dollars are counted in dinars to the nearest” — amount; 1 to 100,000 IQD, whole; default 250 IQD; for the whole café. “Purchase orders a manager approves, up to” — amount; 0 to 1,000,000,000 IQD, whole; default 250,000 IQD (owner and general manager: 1,000,000,000); for the whole café, a role. “Stock sent to another branch is charged at cost plus (%)” — percent; 0 to 100; 0 shows “At cost”; default 0 (at cost); for the whole café (branch rows not added here). “Overtime is paid at (% of an hour's pay)” — percent; 100 to 300; default 150%; for the whole café. “Late, or leaving early, by more than” — minutes; 0 to 120, whole; default 5 minutes; for the whole café. “Someone still clocked in after” — hours; 4 to 24, whole; default 16 hours; for the whole café. “Salaries are paid on the day of the month” — day; 1 to 28, whole; default Day 1 of the month; for the whole café. “Customers earn points, and take rewards” — choice; “On”, “Off”; default On; for the whole café. “A customer earns a point for every” — amount; 1 to 1,000,000 IQD, whole; default 1,000 IQD; for the whole café. “A reward takes” — points; 1 to 100,000, whole; Each row says its kind (“Screen”, “Product”, “Stock item”, “Customer”, “Supplier”, “Staff”, “Purchase order”, “Journal”). Up to 5 of each kind.

controls.does: Opens or closes Find anything from any screen.

controls.label: Arrow up / Arrow down
controls.does: Moves between the rows.

controls.label: Enter
controls.does: Opens the chosen row.

controls.label: Escape
controls.does: Closes the box (or tap outside it).

parts.name: Offline
parts.shows: When the device loses internet: the badge says “Offline” and a red banner under the top bar says “Offline — the till keeps quick sales and table bills and sends them when the connection returns. Nothing else is saved until then.” On POS only, a chip beside the drawer says the queue's state: “No internet · selling offline”, “No internet · {n} sale(s) kept on this till”, “Sending {n} sale(s) made offline…”, “{n} sale(s) made offline waiting to send”, “{n} offline sale(s) need a manager”, and “· {n} bill(s) kept on this till” (details on the POS entry). A page opened with no connection at all shows “No connection” with “Sales cannot be recorded while the till is offline. Nothing is being saved. Take payment only once the connection is back, or write the sale down and ring it up when it returns.”

parts.name: Place switch (on stock screens and the till)
parts.shows: Not in the frame itself: on Inventory, Stock Count, Usage, Transfers, Production, Purchasing and What to buy a list “Stock at”, and on POS “Till at” (branches only), shown when there is more than one place. A till at a place that sells nothing offers “Sell at {place}” buttons.

controls.label: Stock at / Till at
controls.does: Chooses where this device works. Stock screens show and record at that place; the till sells at that branch.
controls.after: Kept on this device for a year. The stock screens refresh; the till reloads with that branch's menu, prices, bills and drawer.

parts.name: Undo (after some saves)
parts.shows: After saving a product's details, the week's schedule or the tables, a green bar shows what was saved with “Undo ({n})”, counting down 10 seconds. Sales, payments and anything in the books are never undone this way (they have void, refund or reverse).

controls.label: Undo ({n})
controls.does: Saves what was there before. Then “Undone: as it was before.”; if refused, the reason shows.

parts.name: Tour
parts.shows: On POS, Production and Dashboard, a one-time offer: “New here? Let us show you around this screen.” The tour lights one part at a time with a card: “Step {n} of {total}”, a title and a sentence.

controls.label: Show me around
controls.does: Starts the tour.

controls.label: No thanks
controls.does: Hides the offer on this device for good (the menu item still starts it).

controls.label: Next / Finish
controls.does: Next step; on the last, ends it.

controls.label: Back
controls.does: Previous step.

controls.label: End the tour
controls.does: Ends it. Escape does too; the arrow keys go on and back.

parts.name: Something's wrong?
parts.shows: A box: “Say in a word or two what went wrong. The screen you are on goes with it, so nobody has to ask.”, a text box (example “The receipt printed twice”) and “On: {page}”. The device's connection, screen size, language, browser and the last error the page saw are sent with it.

controls.label: What went wrong?
controls.does: Your words.
controls.rules: 2 to 500 letters.

controls.label: Send
controls.does: Sends the report.
controls.rules: Off until 2 letters are typed.
controls.after: The owner and managers see it on Reported problems and the Dashboard. Sent once even if the connection drops.

controls.label: Close
controls.does: Closes the box.

parts.name: Phone warnings (push alerts)
parts.shows: Once the owner turns them on in Settings, each person who sees the Dashboard can turn them on, on My account → “Warnings on this phone”: “Only the urgent (red) ones” box, “Turn on warnings on this phone”, then “On: every warning” or “On: the urgent ones only”, “Send a test”, “Turn off on this phone”. The Dashboard's warnings then arrive on the phone in the person's language within about five minutes; a red one stays on screen until tapped; tapping opens the page to act on it.

controls.label: Turn on warnings on this phone
controls.does: Asks the phone for permission and registers it.
controls.who: Those who see profit (owner, general manager, branch manager, accountant, auditor).

controls.label: Send a test
controls.does: Sends a test warning to this phone.

controls.label: Turn off on this phone
controls.does: Stops warnings to this phone.

parts.name: Sign out
parts.shows: At the bottom of My account.

controls.label: Sign out
controls.does: Ends your sign-in on this device and opens the sign-in page.

parts.name: When a screen fails to load
parts.shows: Instead of the page: “This screen could not be loaded” and “The information could not be read from the database, so nothing is shown rather than something incomplete. Nothing has been changed.” then “If it keeps happening, tell the owner, and quote reference {ref}.” (or without a reference).

controls.label: Try again
controls.does: Loads the screen again.

parts.name: When a screen is not allowed
parts.shows: The menu shows only screens your roles open. Typing another screen's address sends you to your own start screen (Dashboard, Reports, Production, POS, Stock Count, Purchasing, Inventory or My account) with no message. Not signed in: the sign-in page, which brings you back to the screen afterwards. Second step not done: the code page. Login not linked or deactivated: My account says “Your login is not linked to the business yet”. If a button is pressed that your role may not use, the database refuses it and nothing is saved.

messages.text: Offline — the till keeps quick sales and table bills and sends them when the connection returns. Nothing else is saved until then.
messages.when: The device lost internet.
messages.do: Sell quick sales and table bills only; wait for the connection for anything else.

messages.text: No internet · selling offline
messages.when: On POS, offline with nothing kept yet.
messages.do: Carry on selling quick sales.

messages.text: No internet · {n} sale(s) kept on this till
messages.when: On POS, offline with sales kept.
messages.do: Keep the device on; they are sent when the internet is back.

messages.text: Sending {n} sale(s) made offline…
messages.when: On POS, the connection is back.
messages.do: Wait.

messages.text: {n} sale(s) made offline waiting to send
messages.when: On POS, sales still to send.
messages.do: Wait, or open the chip to see them.

messages.text: {n} offline sale(s) need a manager
messages.when: On POS, the database refused some kept sales.
messages.do: A manager opens the chip and sends again, records at today's price, or takes one off the till.

messages.text: No connection
messages.when: A page was opened with no internet at all.
messages.do: Wait for the connection; write sales down and ring them up later.

messages.text: Nothing found for “{q}”.
messages.when: Find anything found nothing.
messages.do: Try fewer letters, or another word.

messages.text: Undone: as it was before.
messages.when: Undo worked.
messages.do: Nothing.

messages.text: Thank you. The owner will see it, with this screen.
messages.when: A problem was reported.
messages.do: Nothing.

messages.text: Say in a word or two what went wrong
messages.when: The report is shorter than 2 letters.
messages.do: Type a little more.

messages.text: No answer: try again in a moment.
messages.when: The report could not reach the app.
messages.do: Press Send again; it is sent once only.

messages.text: This screen could not be loaded
messages.when: The screen's information could not be read.
messages.do: Press Try again. If it repeats, tell the owner with the reference.

messages.text: If it keeps happening, tell the owner, and quote reference {ref}.
messages.when: Under a failed screen.
messages.do: Give the owner the reference.

messages.text: Your login is not linked to the business yet
messages.when: Signed in with an email not on Settings → People, or deactivated.
messages.do: “Ask the owner to add you under Settings → People with exactly this email. Once they have, sign out and sign in again.”

messages.text: You do not have permission to do this (needs {1})
messages.when: A press your role may not make; {1} is the permission.
messages.do: Ask a manager who holds it.

messages.text: You do not have permission to do that.
messages.when: The database refused a read or write for your role.
messages.do: Ask a manager.

messages.text: Sign in to continue
messages.when: The sign-in ended.
messages.do: Sign in again.

messages.text: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
messages.when: The sign-in expired.
messages.do: Sign in again; then do it once more.

messages.text: Finish signing in: type the code from your authenticator app
messages.when: Two-step sign-in not finished.
messages.do: Type the code on the code page.

messages.text: The database did not answer, so this may have been saved. Check before trying again.
messages.when: No answer came back from the database.
messages.do: Check whether it was saved before doing it again.

messages.text: Your previous submission may already have been saved. Checking…
messages.when: A save with no answer is being sent again by itself (up to three times).
messages.do: Wait.

messages.text: Still no answer. It may have been saved: press the same button again to check. It will not be recorded twice.
messages.when: Three tries got no answer.
messages.do: Press the same button again when the connection is back.

messages.text: This screen sent no retry key: reload the page and try again.
messages.when: The page is old or broken.
messages.do: Reload the page.

messages.text: This retry does not match what was first sent: reload the page and check before doing it again
messages.when: A retry was sent with different details.
messages.do: Reload and check whether it was saved.

messages.text: This was sent by someone else
messages.when: A retry key belongs to another person.
messages.do: Reload the page.

messages.text: That has already been recorded.
messages.when: The same thing was saved twice.
messages.do: Check; nothing more to do.

messages.text: The database is missing an update this screen needs (a migration has not been applied yet).
messages.when: The database is older than the app.
messages.do: Tell whoever looks after the system.

messages.text: The database refused the change.
messages.when: A refusal with no reason given.
messages.do: Check the form, or report it with Something's wrong?.

skipped_messages: The till's offline dialog (Sales made offline, Send again, Record at today's price, Take it off this till…) belongs to the POS entry.

what_if.case: I cannot find a screen in the menu
what_if.do: Look under More. If it is not there either, your roles do not open it: ask the owner.

what_if.case: The internet drops during service
what_if.do: Keep selling quick sales and table bills on the till; they are sent when it returns. Do not record expenses or stock until then.

what_if.case: A screen shows “This screen could not be loaded”
what_if.do: Press Try again. If it repeats, press Something's wrong? and say what you were doing.

what_if.case: The app is in the wrong language on this device
what_if.do: Choose the language in the top bar; it is kept on this device.

tips: Ctrl+K finds any screen or record fast.
Type a sale's receipt number in Find anything to jump to it on Orders.
Something's wrong? sends the screen with your words, so nobody has to ask which screen.
